updates.title: New Built-in Entra Role: SOC Identity Responder
updates.summary: Microsoft Entra introduced a new built-in role designed for security operations center (SOC) analysts to perform identity containment actions from Microsoft Defender using least-privilege access. This eliminates the previous requirement for SOC teams to hold multiple high-privilege Entra roles or depend on identity administrators, reducing response delays during security incidents.

updates.title: Microsoft Entra Backup and Recovery Generally Available
updates.summary: Microsoft Entra Backup and Recovery is now generally available as a built-in solution for tenant recovery from accidental or malicious changes. The service automatically backs up critical directory objects including users, groups, applications, Conditional Access policies, and authentication policies, with no additional configuration required.

updates.title: Extended Conditional Access Protections for AI Agent User Accounts
updates.summary: Conditional Access now supports targeting and protecting AI agent user accounts with greater precision using Custom Security Attributes, agent-specific risk detection, and compliance requirements. Organizations can now apply granular policies to secure AI agents alongside human users.

updates.title: External Users Can Be Directly Assigned to Access Packages
updates.summary: Entitlement Management now allows admins to directly assign external users to access packages using email addresses without pre-existing directory entries. External users are automatically invited as guests and governed through the access package workflow.

updates.title: Domainless SAML IdP Federation for Workforce Tenants
updates.summary: Microsoft Entra now supports domainless SAML federation, allowing external users to authenticate using their IdP-managed credentials without requiring domain matching between email addresses and preconfigured IdP domains. This simplifies B2B access management and reduces federation configuration overhead.

updates.title: Prevent Unauthorized Changes to AD Groups with AD Group Enforcement
updates.summary: A new preview capability in Entra Cloud Sync allows organizations to designate specific Active Directory groups so modifications can only occur through the Entra provisioning service, preventing drift and maintaining consistency between Entra and on-premises AD. Changes made outside the provisioning service are blocked.

updates.title: BYOD Support for Windows Clients Using Entra Registration
updates.summary: Bring Your Own Device (BYOD) support for Windows clients using Entra registration is now generally available. Administrators can assign the Private Application traffic profile to users with internal accounts, simplifying BYOD deployment without prior device requirements.

updates.title: Jailbreak/Root Detection in Authenticator App
updates.summary: Microsoft Authenticator now detects and blocks rooted or jailbroken devices from adding or using work or school accounts, enforcing secure-by-default device compliance. Users on non-compliant devices are blocked until they migrate to compliant hardware.

updates.title: SCIM 2.0 APIs for Microsoft Entra ID in US Gov Cloud
updates.summary: SCIM 2.0 APIs are now generally available in the US Gov cloud, providing a standards-based option for managing users and groups in Microsoft Entra. This enables easier integration with third-party identity management systems in government environments.

updates.title: Improved Reliability for Microsoft Entra Kerberos Key Rotation
updates.summary: Microsoft Entra Kerberos key rotation now includes enhanced validation logic to handle incoming trust referral flows more reliably. The system attempts decryption with both primary and secondary keys, preventing authentication failures that previously occurred during key rotation in referral scenarios.

updates.title: DLP Controls Prevent Copilot Processing of External Emails
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP now blocks Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat from processing emails from senders external to an organization. This mitigates risks of sensitive data exposure and prompt injection attacks when Copilot accesses external email as grounding data.

updates.title: DLP Safeguards Prevent Copilot External Web Searches with Sensitive Data
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP now extends to prevent Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat from using sensitive data in external web searches. This real-time control reduces data leakage and oversharing risks by blocking potentially exposed sensitive information.

updates.title: DLP Sensitivity Label Protections for Copilot Extend to All Storage Locations
updates.summary: The Microsoft Purview DLP policy restricting Copilot from processing files with sensitivity labels now applies regardless of file storage location. Previously limited to specific locations, this expanded scope ensures consistent data protection across Word, Excel, and PowerPoint regardless of where files are stored.

updates.title: DLP File Quarantine Action for SharePoint and OneDrive
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP now includes a file quarantine action that automatically moves triggered files to a restricted, admin-controlled quarantine location on SharePoint and OneDrive. This instantly removes user access while preserving files for investigation, providing immediate containment of sensitive data exposure.

updates.title: Data Security Investigations Integration with Endpoint DLP Alerts
updates.summary: Data Security Investigations now integrates with endpoint DLP alerts, allowing analysts to launch investigations directly from alerts and automatically gather related exfiltrated files for review. This accelerates forensic analysis by aggregating files tied to specific DLP events.

updates.title: DLP Event Data in Graph API for Defender Alert Enrichment
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP event data is now available in the Graph API alongside alert data, enabling easier correlation and SIEM integration. Organizations can now export comprehensive DLP and alert information through a single API to streamline incident response and reporting workflows.

updates.title: DLP and Auto-Labeling Extend to Non-Microsoft Connected Apps
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP and Information Protection auto-labeling capabilities now extend to non-Microsoft applications including Google Workspace, Box, Dropbox, Salesforce, ServiceNow, AWS, and Cisco Webex. Supported actions and conditions vary by application, expanding data protection beyond Microsoft 365.

updates.title: Auto-Labeling Scale Increase for SharePoint and OneDrive
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview auto-labeling maximum capacity for SharePoint and OneDrive has increased from 100,000 to 500,000 files per tenant per day. This enables organizations to close labeling gaps faster, protecting more data at rest and preparing data estates for Microsoft 365 Copilot with greater confidence.

updates.title: Apply Default SharePoint Library Labels to Data at Rest
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview Information Protection now auto-labels existing SharePoint files to match the default sensitivity label configured on their document library. This eliminates labeling gaps for data at rest and enforces consistent, secure-by-default protection without requiring manual user intervention.

updates.title: Archive OneDrive and SharePoint Files Under Retention
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management now supports retention-based file archiving that moves inactive content to low-cost storage while keeping data discoverable. This reduces storage costs without compromising compliance or reducing Copilot result relevance.
